TD-05.A // SUPPLY FLOW

Global maritime delivery.

Direct supply channels configured to contract ocean delivery protocols.

01 // PORT TERMINAL

Port of Tianjin dispatch

Our proximity to North China's largest maritime port (Port of Tianjin) eliminates long domestic trucking stages, ensuring that container loading and customs sealing happen under our team's direct QA inspection.

02 // CONTRACT TERMS

FOB & CIF terms

We coordinate supply under standard ocean commercial terms. We handle direct loading for Free on Board (FOB) terms, or manage shipping vessel bookings and marine insurance under Cost, Insurance, and Freight (CIF) terms.

03 // PACKAGING RULES

B2B packaging standards

Scaffolding tubes and vertical posts are bundled with high-tensile steel straps, fitted with protective end caps, and loaded onto heavy-duty wooden pallet blocks to facilitate forklift discharge at the project site.

04 // DOCUMENTS

Customs manifest clearance

We process ocean shipping documentation including Bills of Lading (B/L), Commercial Invoice schedules, detailed Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin (CO), and required steel Mill Test Certificates.

TD-05.B // LOGISTICS METRICS

Freight specifications.

Typical container packing configurations and shipping durations from Tianjin Port.

LOGISTICS PARAMETER SPECIFICATION SUMMARY
Standard Container Size 20ft General Purpose (GP) or 40ft High Cube (HC) depending on cargo length profile (e.g. 5.8m scaffolding tubes fit 20ft containers).
Max Weight per Container Nominal 25 to 28 Metric Tons depending on target port limits and shipping line regulations.
Bundling Protocols Secured with steel straps, standard bundle weight ~1 to 1.5 Metric Tons per pack, tagged with batch code markers.
Port of Loading Tianjin Port (Xingang, China), Port Code: CNTSN.
Export Clearance Duration 3 to 5 business days from vessel cutoff for documentation, customs inspection, and gate-in clearance.
